title: LTX 2.3 lipsync - author and prove the workflow on the bench
description: Third LTX 2.3 v2v front end after extend and foley. NOT a mask polarity - lipdub re-synthesises the video from an LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide in-context guide (EmptyLTXVLatentVideo + LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly + ic-lora-lipdub-0.9 + LTXVSetAudioRefTokens, LTXVCropGuides mandatory), so it is its own workflow file and its own op. Every node and the LoRA are already installed on both 8188 and 48188. Bench authoring only - NOT blocked by MPI-531, which gates app-side Flow authoring, not graph work. App integration follows as its own card. See MPI-4 brief 'Lipsync is NOT a third mask polarity'.
